Official EdoGIS map-request form was indexed and retrieved by search. It requests an area of interest by LGA/town/city/district and lists GIS charting maps, layouts, TDP/TPO and orthophoto products. It is a request/procedure document, not an anonymous parcel API.

Official EdoGIS property-registration guideline was indexed and retrieved by search. It describes vetting/cadastral processing and requires survey-plan and application materials. No parcel geometry or safe native parcel identifier was exposed. Unsafe owner/title/contact data were not requested or retained.
Official Edo State page specifically mentions land administration concerns in Auchi and identifies EdoGIS as the responsible state service context. No public parcel layer or endpoint was exposed.

Official EdoGIS advertisement identifies a parcel at Auchi-Aviele Road, Auchi, with a survey-plan reference and area. Because it is an advert/procedure document and provides no polygon geometry or safe machine-readable parcel identity, no sample was retained and no identity was promoted to a canonical parcel ID.

Direct TLS-verified request returned Cloudflare HTTP 403. No Cloudflare/CAPTCHA bypass, login, credentials, private token, or TLS-disablement was attempted. This is an access outcome only, not evidence of absence.
